features.name: Study Note Sharing
features.description: Students upload, browse, and download study notes organized by university, course, and topic.
user_stories: As a student, I can upload notes with course and topic tags so that peers can find them.
As a student, I can search and filter notes by course so that I find relevant material quickly.
acceptance_criteria: Given I am logged in, When I upload a PDF or image note with a title and course, Then it appears in the course note list.
Given notes exist, When I search by keyword or course filter, Then matching notes are returned sorted by relevance.

features.name: Study Groups
features.description: Students create, join, and manage study groups around courses or subjects.
user_stories: As a student, I can create a public or private study group so that I can study with classmates.
As a group admin, I can approve or remove members so that the group stays focused and safe.
acceptance_criteria: Given I am logged in, When I create a group with a name and course, Then I become its admin and the group is listed.
Given a private group, When a student requests to join, Then the admin sees the request and can approve or reject it.

features.name: User Authentication and Profiles
features.description: Students register with a university email and maintain a profile with their courses and interests.
user_stories: As a student, I can sign up with my university email so that my student status is verified.
As a student, I can edit my profile and courses so that others can find me for study groups.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid university email, When I register and confirm the verification link, Then my account is activated.
Given I am logged in, When I update my profile, Then the changes are saved and visible to other users.

features.name: Note Interaction and Feedback
features.description: Students rate, comment on, and bookmark notes to surface quality content.
user_stories: As a student, I can rate and comment on notes so that I give feedback to the author.
As a student, I can bookmark notes so that I can revisit them later.
acceptance_criteria: Given I view a note, When I submit a 1-5 star rating, Then the note's average rating updates immediately.
Given I bookmark a note, When I open my bookmarks page, Then the note is listed there.

features.name: Moderation and Reporting
features.description: Users report inappropriate or copyrighted content and moderators review and act on reports.
user_stories: As a student, I can report a note or comment so that inappropriate content is reviewed.
As a moderator, I can remove content and suspend users so that the platform remains safe.
acceptance_criteria: Given I view a note, When I submit a report with a reason, Then the report appears in the moderator queue.
Given a reported note, When a moderator removes it, Then it is hidden from all users and the author is notified.

non_functional_requirements.requirement: Pages load in under 2 seconds and search returns results in under 1 second at 500 concurrent users.
All traffic uses HTTPS, passwords are hashed with bcrypt, and uploaded files are scanned for malware.
The platform maintains 99.5% monthly uptime excluding scheduled maintenance.
Users can delete their account and personal data within 30 days, in line with GDPR.
